exports.entries.edits: entries must be {add: [{from, to, format?, kinds?}], remove: [{from, to?}]} (a whole list of entries is not taken; the entries now: export_read with this export as target)
exports.entries.list: {key} must be a list of {from, to, format, kinds}
exports.entries.noRow: {at}: there is no entry from "{from}"{to} (this export's entries: {rows})
exports.entries.removeItem: {at} must be {from, to?} or a from as a string (to picks one of the entries with the same from)
exports.entries.removeList: entries.remove must be a list of {from, to}
exports.entry.formatFolder: {at}: the format "{format}" writes one file. The to "{to}" is a folder, so give a file path (for example types.schema.json). A folder takes documents (Markdown), SVG and HTML, which have no format
exports.entry.kindTo: {at}: {kind} in kinds cannot be written to "{to}": {problem} (a flow is written to one .md file, or by an entry for each flow card)
exports.entry.kindsList: {at}: kinds must be a list of card kind names
exports.entry.kindsOnlySection: {at}: kinds is only for writing from a section (from is a card here)
exports.entry.needFrom: {at} needs from (the path of the card or section to export)
exports.entry.needTo: {at} needs to (the file to write, or a folder if it ends with /)
exports.entry.stray: {stray} cannot be written in {at} (from, to, format, kinds)
exports.entry.takesNothing: {at}: this entry writes no card now (an entry of a section with no kinds takes no flow, and notes only from a schema section)
exports.entry.workdir: {at}: a working directory's section and what is in it are not exported (they are read from a folder, and so are the notes put there)
exports.ids.item: {key}[{i}] must be a card or section path
exports.ids.list: {key} must be a list of card or section paths
exports.keys.dir: dir cannot be written in the value of {tool} (an export does not point at a working directory; give where to write in the targetdir of export_execute, and set this Mac's default with path)
exports.keys.stray: {stray} cannot be written in the value of {tool} ({allowed})
exports.named.none: There is no export "{name}" (there are none yet; make one with export_create)
exports.path.inCard: {raw} is a place inside a card. What can be exported is a card, a section, or a version of a stackdoc
exports.path.noCard: The card "{raw}" is not in main
exports.path.noSection: The section "{section}" is not in main (for a card, write <section>:<card>)
exports.target.needed: export_delete needs an export name in target
exports.target.one: Write one export name in the target of {tool}
exports.update.nameString: name is the new name (a string)
exports.update.nothing: There is nothing to change (put name, path, entries or exclude in value)
exports.what.name: export name
